nights.title: TYLA - THE A*POP WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Tyla
nights.extract: Tyla Laura Seethal known mononymously as Tyla, is a South African singer-songwriter. Dubbed the "Queen of Popiano", her musical style is characterised by a fusion of pop and amapiano.

en.who: Tyla Laura Seethal, known as Tyla, is a South African singer-songwriter. Dubbed the "Queen of Popiano", her style fuses pop and amapiano.
facts: Her musical style is characterised by a fusion of pop and amapiano.
She is dubbed the "Queen of Popiano".
